note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected overlays plus true level head profiles checked against neutral render; topology, junction surface and slit depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: Continuous curved head with a full-thickness oblique slit. The declared semicircular floor replaces the earlier flat termination; solid wood remains below it. Width, angle and the original edge bevel are preserved.
internal_features.finial: The restored tall head, seated button and deep slit retain their exact controls from checkpoint 024.
internal_features.collars: All three rims use thinner turned edges with softened corners, guided by the current king and queen. Front-rim locations and the original silhouette are checked at the unchanged 54-degree camera.
internal_features.lower_body: The base has a shallower groove and a continuous rounded flare. The socket rolls into the stem rather than ending in a flat ledge. The existing foot width, total height and upper stem are retained.
internal_features.limits: This is a local style revision, not an exact shared scaled base. The bishop still follows its own authoritative reference. Wood and lights remain inherited and unfinished.
